members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the Popover is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the Popover starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: dismissable
members.doc: Whether Escape, an outside press, and the trigger close the Popover. When false, only a button in the close slot closes it, in modal and non-modal mode alike.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the Popover opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the Popover and its trigger, along the placement's side.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the Popover is placed against.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the Popover moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the Popover and the edge of its boundary: the viewport, or the element boundaryRef names. Must not be negative.

members.name: modal
members.doc: Whether the Popover contains focus until it closes. When false, it is non-blocking: it has no focus containment, outside-content exclusion, or scroll locking.

members.name: colorScheme
members.doc: Makes the open Popover a scope of this color scheme, whatever the page's. Its surface is that scheme's raised popup surface, not the strong surface an unscoped Popover has, and its text and any Mux UI component inside follow the scheme. Unset leaves the Popover as the page styles it. A scoped Popover also carries the data-muxui-theme and data-muxui-contrast it reads from its trigger's nearest scope (without a trigger, its anchor's), or from the document root, when it opens. While it is open it follows a change to either on the trigger or its ancestors, and it picks up a replaced trigger node on its next render or the next time it opens.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Reports the Popover opening or closing.

members.name: boundaryRef
members.doc: The element whose box bounds the Popover in place of the viewport: it flips, shifts and caps its width and height to stay inside it, containerPadding from its edges. The ref is read after each render of the Popover; with no element in the document there, the viewport bounds it.

members.name: initialFocusRef
members.doc: An element inside the Popover that takes focus when the Popover opens, in place of the dialog surface, in modal and non-modal mode. One that cannot take focus then is skipped.

members.name: returnFocusRef
members.doc: The element that takes focus when the Popover closes or unmounts and the element focused when it opened cannot take focus back: it has left the document, is hidden or disabled, or focus was on the document body. It applies only when focus has been inside the Popover and would otherwise stay on the document body.

members.name: anchorRef
members.doc: The element the Popover is placed against, in place of its trigger. Without a trigger it is required, and a press on it is not an outside press.
